// diagnostic

E1201

Two versions of one package required

What

Two versions of one package required

Why

A build links one version of each package, and the requirements here can't agree on one

Fix

Select one compatible package version in `package.jet`, then run `jet fetch`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1201: tests/ui/manifest_version_conflict/stderr.

Error [jet.PackageVersionConflict]: Two versions of `mylib` are required
 Why: A package graph can have only one version of each package — two different packages require `mylib` at conflicting versions
 Fix: Choose one version and update the conflicting dependencies:\n  conflict_root → lib_v1 (1.0.0)\n  conflict_root → lib_v2 (2.0.0)
